description: Enrich a person from their email / LinkedIn / name+company / phone using People Data Labs. Returns job title, company, emails, phone numbers, location, and skills. Provide at least one identifier. Example: pdl_person_enrich({ email: "sean@peopledatalabs.com", _apiKey: "your-key" })

_apiKey.description: Your People Data Labs API key (peopledatalabs.com; free tier ~100/mo).

company.description: Company name or domain the person works at, e.g. "People Data Labs" or "peopledatalabs.com"

email.description: Email address of the person, e.g. "sean@peopledatalabs.com"

min_likelihood.description: Minimum match likelihood, integer 1-10. PDL only returns a person if confidence meets this floor.

name.description: Full name of the person, e.g. "Sean Thorne" (best combined with `company`)

phone.description: Phone number of the person, e.g. "+14155551234"

name: pdl_person_enrich
title: Pdl Person Enrich
